_comment: Tier-2 for febio::hyperelasticity#0. A Mooney-Rivlin material without <k> gives 'K must be a positive number.' and exit 1; the same material with <k> runs to normal termination; and the shipped coupled neo-Hookean, which has no <k> parameter at all, also runs. All three are required, because the claim is the DISTINCTION between coupled and uncoupled materials, not the message alone. Executed 2026-08-06 on FEBio 4.12.0.86045466d (source build, USE_MKL=OFF). MUTATION CONTROL (2026-08-07): T2_MUTATE=1 neutralises the L.swap / L.drop edits this fixture uses to turn a correct deck into a broken one, so every deck it builds is the correct one and the pitfall is never triggered. Unmutated the fixture still PASSES; mutated it FAILS because the expectation 'uncoupled_needs_k=reproduced' is no longer printed and the forbidden token 'not_reproduced' appears. Re-verify with `cd <fixture dir> && T2_MUTATE=1 ~/Schreibtisch/open-fem-agent/.venv/bin/python source.py` (the mutation branch lives in source.py, so the proof is one command and needs no external harness).
